description: Office of the Governor-Uva Province - Appointments made by the Governor of Uva Province
categorisation: This gazette exclusively contains government personnel appointments (e.g., "Mr. T. Gajendrakumar... to act as the Municipal Commissioner," "Mr. L. D. S. Priyantha... as the Director of Internal Audit"). It names specific individuals and their basic titles/positions but does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas. The content focuses solely on who is being appointed to which positions, fitting the criteria for Type 2 (People Gazette).
